prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several unexpected winning updates (including copy, hint, and redesign changes) performed better than predicted.
Evidence is still thin for adoption wait_info, choose_path hint, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) remained effective, winning in 4 of 6 tests (+9.4%, +5.7%, +4.3%, and +4.4%).
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 2 of 7 tests (+4.2% and +4.0%), while the remaining 5 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
No clear effect was seen across tests for adoption copy, choose_path layout, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, sign_in hint, and sign_in notification.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Calling Practice Flow: Adds an interactive mini-practice element on the final screen where users try calling and hiding their pet before launching to the desktop. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries after setup regarding how to show, hide, or talk to the pet on the desktop, and interactive finish flows show strong historic test wins.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Companion Creation Stage Status Monitor: Displays active stage progress steps and rendering activity updates while the desktop pet is generating in the background. (why: Home step wait time is the longest in the funnel (mean 2336s), and structured wait_info updates on the waiting screen have previously delivered positive retention gains.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Path Style Preference Quiz Flow: Adds interactive quick-choice cards on the path selection screen to help users instantly choose between active or calm pet behaviors. (why: Although choose_path has an 86.2% conversion, the mean time spent is 514s; providing interactive quick choices helps guide prompt decision making.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Trait Confirmation Flow: Introduces an interactive trait confirmation preview on the adoption certificate screen where users toggle companion personality tags. (why: The adoption stage suffers the largest funnel drop-off (67.2% conversion, mean 1017s), and adding active confirmation increases user attachment.)
4: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Voice Tuning Practice Flow: Adds an audio sample player component to the waiting screen allowing users to test pet chirps and voice sounds while waiting. (why: Waiting during pet generation takes significant time (median 201s), and interactive wait flows reduce perceived waiting friction.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Summon and Visibility Guidance Hint: Displays a clear hint on the finish screen explaining how to bring the pet back if hidden or minimized. (why: Multiple support tickets mentioned post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding and bringing back the pet on the screen.)
6: [sign_in, wait_info] Cloud Pet Account Preservation Status Info: Adds clear hint copy and account state information on sign_in clarifying that logging in retains pet data across reinstalls. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) involved lost or reset pets upon signing back in, making account persistence explicit at sign_in crucial.)
7: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Photo Quality Verification Checklist Info: Displays a photo clarity checklist on the photo upload screen to help users upload compatible pet images. (why: Three support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearances during adoption photo setup.)

scores.note: Interactive finish flows have high historical win rate (+3.5% avg, up to +9.4%), backed by support requests on pet controls, though requires new UI flow.
Home step has low drop-off (9.4%) but high mean wait time (2336s). Home wait_info historic lift is modest (+1.7%).
Choose_path already converts high at 86.2% with no direct support mail evidence; new interactive quiz flow carries development cost.
Adoption has the biggest funnel drop-off (67.2% conversion), but new flows on adoption carry high implementation cost and mixed historical adoption results.
Home new_flow shows steady +1.9% historical gain and helps fill long wait time, though home drop-off rate is relatively low.
Addresses explicit support issues post-setup with simple config-only hint change, though finish drop-off is already small (9.6%).
Sign_in drops 23% of users and represents the #1 support issue (8 emails); low implementation cost via text/info update.
Targets the highest drop-off step (adoption, 67.2%), aligned with support tickets and supported by strong initial adoption wait_info data (+5.2%).
